_help: One entry per Roboflow Universe dataset. Copy workspace / project / version from the dataset URL:
format: 'folder' for classification datasets, 'yolov8' for object detection (each box is cut out as a leaf photo).
class_map: Roboflow class name -> our label (configs/classes.json). Classes not listed are skipped.
Map leaves of plants we don't support (pepper, potato, grape, ...) to other_plant: they teach the plant head.
Run with --list-classes first to see the dataset's class names, then fill class_map.
Set enabled to true when an entry is filled in.
